messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] issues installing
parts:
Hi,
I just tried the installation instruction here and it worked, I'm using 3.1.1 as well:
https://github.com/al2na/methylKit/tree/development

It is for the development version of the package, but the main difference is that some bugs are fixed in the development version ( I will push this as the main version when I get the chance). The problem you are having might be windows specific as well, but the package used to work on windows machines without problem.

I suggest you start a fresh R session and try the installation instructions from link above 

Best,
Altuna
